message.content: An editorial illustration serves as the cover for "TEMPO" magazine, dated 12-18 JANUARI 2026. Set against a solid yellow-gold background, a white three-dimensional rectangular box labeled "KPU" with four black dots above the text sits in the upper center. A trail of dark, grainy material, resembling gunpowder, leads from the base of this box toward the center. Two male figures in profile face each other from the left and right edges. The figure on the left, with dark skin and a wide grin, holds a lit wooden matchstick. The flame is orange and yellow, positioned just above the end of the dark trail. The figure on the right has lighter skin and a rounded face, holding one hand near his chin with a contemplative expression. Both figures wear collared shirts. Bold white text in the lower right reads "CEK OMBAK DEMOKRASI KOMANDO." Smaller text below mentions "Prabowo Subianto," "kepala daerah," and "Orde Baru." Other legible text includes "Takluk di Depan Jaksa Pemeras" and "Telat Unggah Dokumen APBN."
